about: The crypt's Fallen vault (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB13): a fight room, a floating slab of the crypt's flagstones; its landmark the vault's middle column fallen across the floor under the shaft of light, four pillars standing round it. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), held straight under its sockets (west, east, north, south) by pins. tools/ground_shape.py draws arena_12_ground.tscn and its art from this.
